hazards.evidence: Long white cord snaking across the wooden floor walkway from the right counter/dishwasher area into the foreground, directly in the walker path.
Wet spill/puddle with scattered debris on the wood floor in front of the left counter/stove run, creating a slippery surface.
Stacks of frequently used plates, bowls, and dishes stored on high open wall shelves on the left, requiring overhead reaching.
Baskets and items stored on the lowest open shelf at floor level under the left counter, requiring deep bending to retrieve.
Strong direct sunlight streaming across the floor creating a bright glare patch and high contrast on the walking surface near the spill.
